name: Roman (book face)
note: Rough default: a Caslon or Garamond weight roman in upper and lower case.

name: Gothic (sans serif)
note: Rough default: a Franklin or News Gothic weight sans in upper and lower case.

name: Condensed
note: Rough default for a condensed gothic or roman.

name: Extended
note: Rough default for an extended (wide) gothic or copperplate.

name: Typewriter (monospaced)
note: Most typewriter faces set every character, including the space, on 0.6 em.
